questions.skill: Explain SSS congruence with rigid motions
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: In △ABC and △DEF, AB = DE, BC = EF, and CA = FD. Explain, using rigid motions, why △ABC ≅ △DEF.
questions.prompt_markup: In △ABC and △DEF, AB = DE, BC = EF, and CA = FD. Explain, using rigid motions, why △ABC ≅ △DEF.
questions.correct_answer: A translation and a rotation carry A to D and B to E; if needed, the reflection across DE carries C′ to F.
questions.required_method: Move A to D and B to E (translation and rotation, using AB = DE). If the image C′ of C is not F, show that line DE is the perpendicular bisector of C′F, so the reflection across DE carries C′ to F.
questions.grading_note: Any valid explanation. Essential: (1) A → D, B → E (AB = DE); (2) DC′ = DF and EC′ = EF (rigid motions keep lengths); (3) if C′ ≠ F, D and E are each equidistant from C′ and F, so line DE is the perpendicular bisector of C′F; (4) the reflection across DE fixes D and E and maps C′ to F. Alternative: C′ and F both lie on the circles centered at D and E with these radii, which meet in at most one point on each side of DE. Invalid: using angles (none are given); citing SSS to prove SSS.

questions.skill: Explain the Hypotenuse-Leg criterion for right triangles
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Right triangles ABC and DEF have right angles at C and F, hypotenuses AB = DE, and legs AC = DF. Prove that △ABC ≅ △DEF.
questions.prompt_markup: Right triangles ABC and DEF have right angles at C and F, hypotenuses AB = DE, and legs AC = DF. Prove that △ABC ≅ △DEF.
questions.correct_answer: △ABC ≅ △DEF by SSS (BC = EF from the Pythagorean Theorem).
questions.required_method: Use the Pythagorean Theorem to show BC = EF, then apply SSS.
